note: What a server sends as a camp of units that belong to no side is emptied. A client marks the camp empty, even one that had just filled. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The unit credited with emptying it.

fields.name: timerKind
fields.note: Which clock the client shows for it.

fields.name: returnsAt
fields.note: When the camp fills again, in seconds.

bits.name: speak
bits.note: Set where the client says something about it. A server sets it.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined; a server writes zero.
